text:
Sasha: Heads-up — follow-up on the Newton on-prem outage (VPC peering flaps + agent reconnects). Root cause looks like peering route instability + aggressive agent backoff. We need owners/timelines for audit + fix.
Ana: Thanks. Can we split into (1) peering config audit, (2) on‑prem agent backoff + logs, (3) short-term mitigation/rollout plan?
Mike: I'll own the peering config audit. Will run the peering checklist against staging and collect diff. ETA: EOD Thu. Creating ticket RD-3412.
Dilip: I'll take the agent healthchecks + code fix. Need the full agent logs from the customer to repro reconnect pattern. Planning to add a probe to the installer to surface kernel drops.
Juniper: Uploading logs now: s3://redwood-cust/newton/agent-logs-2149999999.tar.gz. Saw repeated 502 responses and kernel OOM/kern_drop at ~02:15 UTC.
Sasha: For short-term mitigation propose enabling a scoped fallback to public egress for monitoring/health traffic: config flag `allow_public_fallback=true` (monitoring-only). Who can own a canary rollout?
Mike: I can do the canary. Plan: 10% of onprem nodes tonight, monitor error rates & latency for 2 hours, ramp to 100% by Fri 12:00 PT if stable. I'll post the dashboard link after the flip.
Ana: I'll update the postmortem doc with owners, timelines, and add a note about recurring peering flaps pattern. Recommend a 15min weekly triage until all action items clear.
Dilip: Created RD-3413 for the agent backoff fix (PR coming). Assigning RD-3412 -> @Mike, RD-3413 -> @Dilip. Target: full remediation within two weeks (end of sprint).
oncall-bot: Reminder: incident follow-up sync scheduled Thu 16:00 UTC — Zoom: https://zoom.redwood/incident-followup
Juniper: Quick question: will the public fallback send customer request payloads over internet? Need to confirm before flip.
Sasha: Good call — the fallback will be restricted to telemetry & health-check endpoints only, no customer PII or inference payloads. We'll document exactly which endpoints are allowed.
Ana: Security already gave scoped approval for monitoring-only fallback (sec@redwood). I'll attach the approval to the PM doc.
Mike: Canary results: error rate fell from ~18% -> ~2% within 30m of flip for the canary cohort. Dashboard: internal metrics (link posted in #rd-dash).
Dilip: Agent fix PR ready: https://github.com/redwood/agent/pull/987 — reduces reconnect aggressiveness and adds clearer reconnect logs + jitter. Need one more review.
Sasha: Owners recap: peering audit — Mike (RD-3412); agent fix — Dilip (RD-3413); canary & rollout — Mike; postmortem & security attachments — Ana; weekly followups — Sasha running. Closing target: 2026-04-06.
Juniper: Thanks team — we'll keep an eye from the customer's side and flag anything odd.
Sasha: I'll message the customer with the mitigation summary and link the updated postmortem once Ana posts it. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
Ana: Adding a short recurring note in the postmortem: "pattern: intermittent BGP/peering instability correlated with onprem kernel events" so we watch for it in future retros.
Mike: Note for playbook: add step to validate route propagation + confirm MTU and AS path before claiming isolation resolved. I'll add to infra-playbooks.
Dilip: After PR merges I'll cut a hotfix release and schedule the deployment window aligned with Mike's rollout.
Sasha: Perfect. If anything slips, escalate to oncall SRE and we'll reassign. Closing thread draft now — will move actions to Jira and the postmortem doc. Thanks.
